diagnosis: Fixed-capacity pair-context reassignment is not a solution. It reduced pooled one-step accuracy from 0.513644 to 0.439272 and code accuracy from 0.456486 to 0.339491. The 511 dedicated contexts cover 70.99% of training pair occurrences but only 56.12% of code evaluation contexts and 2.86% of technical-prose contexts. The next experiment must attribute degradation between overflow/unseen-context collisions and sparse overconditioning within dedicated contexts before any capacity or semantic change.
